rows.en: ...We're changing our route?
Yes. After the incident in Shanghai, I believe the enemy has learned something of our movements.
Rather than follow the Yangtze to Chongqing, we should head for the North China Plain and its Federation bases,
rows.notes: Sentence continues into row 3; route destination and military bases retained. Measured four-line overflow compressed; Federation is shortened Army reference; destination and bases retained.

rows.en: then take a detour into Sichuan, using the Qinling Mountains as a barrier.
rows.notes: Continues row 2; officer recommends a protected detour. Meaning/grammar correction: now directly continues the recommendation begun in row 2; no fitting compression.

rows.en: Understood. Then we'll take that route.
...We have two possible routes to Chongqing Base.
The first takes us over the Yellow Sea to the Yellow River, then onward with the Qinling Mountains as a barrier...
rows.notes: Trailing route-list ellipsis retained.

rows.en: The second follows the Yangtze from Shanghai.
So we have a northern route and a southern route.
Yes. Giganos forces have landed in northern China, so we're very likely to come under attack on the Yellow River route.
But on the Yangtze route, Tekkoryu may target us. Their headquarters are said to be in southern China.
So either way, the risk is high... Captain, what will you do?
We'll take the Yellow River route. Several Federation bases on the North China Plain will make emergency coordination easier.
rows.notes: Measured four-line overflow compressed. Northern bases, plural several, emergency cooperation and chosen river route retained; Federation abbreviates the full force name.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Misato acknowledges Vega's coverage.

rows.en: Sai Saici, Argo has arrived.
Sai Saici, Argo has arrived.
Oh? You're here sooner than I expected.
...It's been a while, Sai Saici.
Yeah, not since the Baam War, huh? Sorry to make you come all the way to Shaolin Temple.
It's no trouble. Now that it has returned, we in the Shuffle Alliance cannot simply stand by.
rows.notes: It remains unspecified here; later Devil Gundam references settle the subject without an early reveal.

rows.en: Yeah... I couldn't believe my ears when Domon told me about it.
So...where are Chibodee, George and Allenby?
Allenby will be here soon, but the other two said they'll join Domon and the others in space.
...I see.
Well, have a seat for now. I'll get you some tea.
There's something more important...!
rows.notes: Topic shift trails into physical demonstration; not a completed unrelated question.

rows.en: Huh?
Hmph!
A-Argo! What are you doing all of a sudden!?
No kidding. Even if you've got strength to spare, you didn't have to smash through the floorboards.
Hmph, the way you moved... It seems you haven't neglected your training.
Heh, you've still got that ridiculous strength too, old man.
Could he be...the impostor Domon told us about!?
rows.notes: Zuisen doubts visiting Argo is genuine; later revelation confirms he is genuine.
Silence fits all three original occurrences; real Argo before sparring and observing fake foes later.

rows.en: You're determined to fight me, aren't you...!?
Yes.
Fine by me! Take it outside, old man!
Very well.
S-surely you two aren't going to...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted apprehension, completed by Gundam fight in subsequent event.

rows.en: S-surely you two aren't going to...!?
rows.notes: Same deliberate apprehension as row 37.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Reduce Bolt Gundam's HP to 50% or less
rows.notes: Plain objective, one segment and zero @; preserve numerical HP threshold.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Wait, you two!
You're going to fight in your Gundams!?
Of course we are! We're Gundam Fighters!
Besides, it's been a long time since I fought someone I could really go all out against!
Then here I come...!
Yeah! Come on, old man!!
Gundam Fiiight!
Reaaady!
Goooo!!
I-impossible! My self-repair can't keep up!?
rows.notes: Fake Sai defeated; self-repair is literal DG ability, not a UI Resurrection label.

rows.en: That's the limit of power you acquire through anything but your own training...!
rows.notes: Real Argo answers fake Sai; power without personal training condemned.

rows.en: Tch! Daaamn it!!
Guaaah! M-my...my body!!
rows.notes: Fake Argo defeated; interrupted bodily alarm preserved.

rows.en: See that!? That's the power you lot don't have!!
rows.notes: Fake Sai taunts original fighters.

rows.en: N-ngaaaah!!
Tch! The repairs can't keep up...!!
Now you're going to talk! Tell me who brought you lot back to life!!
Hah, knowing that won't do you any good! This world will end sooner or later!!
Your puny power can't do a damn thing about it! Hyahahaha!!
Ah!
Torres, track him!
I can't! His signal has disappeared!
Damn it, that bastard's quick to run away!
We have no choice. Wipe out the remaining enemy units!
Don't think you can beat me with those cheap imitations!
Heh! You lot will never be able to beat us!!
Heh heh heh... You, bound by worthless power, and I, who sought strength for its own sake...
rows.notes: Real Argo contrasts DG-dependent fake with his own pursuit; list comparison deliberately trails into row 67.

rows.en: We'll soon find out which of us is truly stronger...!

rows.notes: Silent reaction retained.

rows.en: Tell me how you want to be beaten this time! I'll cook you up just the way you like!!
rows.notes: Sai retains cooking metaphor leading to Michelo counter-threat.

rows.en: You little shit! I'll drive a flag right through the top of your skull!!
rows.notes: Explicit skull/flag threat and crude insult retained.

rows.en: Next time, I won't stop at turning you into fried chicken!
rows.notes: Argo fried-chicken callback kept literal.

rows.en: Shut up! This time, it's your turn to get crushed underneath!!
rows.notes: Michelo counter-threat retains being crushed underneath.

rows.en: You've tasted DG Cells yourself once... Don't think you can escape!!
I'm not the person you knew anymore! Domon and everyone in the Shuffle Alliance taught me...
rows.notes: Deliberate sentence division; lessons named in row 75.

rows.en: What it means to fight, and how wonderful the bonds we forge with our fists can be!!
rows.notes: Object continuation of taught me in row 74; no invented independent subject.

rows.en: No one told me to keep my hands off you... So I won't hold back!!
rows.notes: Michelo states he has not been ordered to refrain; not a claim of permission from listener.

rows.en: W-what is this guy...!?
This Gundam changes its form to suit the situation, just like a Saucer Beast...!
rows.notes: Duke compares transformable Gundam with Saucer Beast.

rows.en: Y-you bastard! Don't lump my Heaven's Sword in with Saucer Beasts!
rows.notes: Michelo objects to comparison, Heaven's Sword kept as source short unit name. Root sourced source-short Heaven's Sword against Akurasu MX Mech List.

rows.en: With my new power, Heaven's Sword and I are invincible!!
rows.notes: Heaven's Sword is the shortened source name of Gundam Heaven's Sword.

rows.en: Damn it! I'll grab you and turn you into spaghetti!!
Or maybe I'll punch some big holes in you and make macaroni instead!
As if the likes of you could read Heaven's Sword's movements!
I won't let Dragon lose in an aerial battle!
rows.notes: Dragon retains the source shortened unit name; aerial combat is explicit.

rows.en: Hya-ha-ha-ha! Can you keep up with my moves!?
Shut up! Don't think you're the only one who can turn into a bird!!
Hya-ha-ha-ha! A fly could fly as fast as it can and still never catch Heaven's Sword!
Shut up! I'll skewer you with my laser sword and make grilled chicken out of you!
Hya-ha-ha-ha! Hya-ha-ha-ha!!
W-what's with this guy...!? Is that laugh powered by DG Cells too...!?
rows.notes: Shinji wonders whether even Michelo's laugh comes from DG Cells.

rows.en: Idiot Shinji! Quit getting worked up over stupid things!
What's wrong, #男愛称!?
rows.notes: Aqua to Hugo; concerned response to his reaction.

rows.en: So the Devil Gundam really has come back to life...
That devil that wiped out our unit...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate fragment referring to the revived Devil Gundam.

rows.en: Urgh! That impostor moves exactly like Sai Saici!!
rows.notes: Keiun mistakes the combatants for copies; the later real-Argo reveal settles the scene.

rows.en: That's me, all right! You've got some good moves!
Hyahaha! Enjoy talking like that while you still can!!
rows.notes: Impostor Sai Saici taunts the real Sai Saici; prefilled label preserved.

rows.en: Hmm! The fake Argo has the same techniques as the real one, too!!
But they're nothing more than imitations...!
Are they? I have a power you don't... Yes, a wonderful power...!
rows.notes: Impostor Argo claims a power absent from the original.

rows.en: Hm...! That speed!
rows.notes: Retained startled fragment about the speed.

rows.en: The fruits of my training to beat you, old man...
rows.notes: Sentence fragment continues into row103; old man is Argo.

rows.en: They're wasted on a fake, but I'll make an exception and show you!!
His movements are different from before!
rows.notes: Impostor Sai Saici reacts to the real fighter's changed movements.

rows.en: The real thing might stop me, but an imitation never will!
Hmm, this is...!
rows.notes: Retained source trailing reaction.

rows.en: Will this be a repeat of their battle in the Guiana Highlands...!?
...Well done, Sai Saici.
rows.notes: Argo and Sai Saici recognize each other through exchanged blows.

rows.en: Have you gotten a little rusty, old man? Or are you holding back?
I wanted to go all out, but circumstances have changed.
Circumstances...? ...Oh, I get it. So that's what's going on.
Hm...? What is going on?
Could this Argo actually be...?
rows.notes: Retained incomplete question before real-Argo reveal.

rows.en: Heheh, I knew whether you were the real thing the moment we traded blows, old man.
rows.notes: Real Sai Saici already recognized real Argo when their fists met.

rows.en: Th-then...!?
rows.notes: Retained incomplete realization.

rows.en: That's right.
F-forgive me, Argo!
F-forgive me, Argo!
Given the circumstances, there's no need to worry about it.
I'd like to start over with a cup of tea... but we don't have time for that.
...Right.
Come on out! I know you're there!
Hehehe... Looks like you saw through us ages ago.
rows.notes: Impostor Sai Saici emerges after being called out.

rows.en: Yeah, since you figured out you couldn't fool Domon or us...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into row125; speaker addresses impostors.

rows.en: Now you want to pit the originals against the copies, right?
...We can see right through your plans.
Then this'll be quick. Right, old man Argo?
Hehehe... We'll show you the power we've gained, power beyond the originals...!
rows.notes: Impostor Argo boasts that both copies surpass their originals.

rows.en: Sounds fun. Come and get me!!
1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Heh heh heh...
Hyahahaha!!
They can regenerate...!
rows.notes: Restored the regenerating copies as the subject of the source nominal reaction.

rows.en: I knew you'd pull that trick!
Heheheh... Right now, we're evenly matched in strength...
But we can heal our wounds over and over again...
Th-this is bad! Sai Saici and Argo have ordinary flesh-and-blood bodies!
rows.notes: Sai Saici and Argo are the real flesh-and-blood fighters.

rows.en: Eventually, they won't keep up with the enemy's healing and will exhaust themselves!
rows.notes: They refers to the real fighters, whose fatigue cannot keep pace with the copies' healing.

rows.en: That's right! No matter what you do, you can't win!!
What's wrong? What's wrooong!? Where'd all that energy you had before go!?
rows.notes: Impostor taunts the real Sai Saici's apparent loss of momentum.

rows.en: ...Heh, you've really underestimated the Shuffle Alliance.
You certainly have.
What...!?
Let's do it, old man!!
Yeah!
Hm...! What are you planning to do?
Against strength, with skill!
rows.notes: Deliberate preparatory fragment completes in row149; Sai uses skill against Argo-copy's strength.

rows.en: Against skill, with strength!
rows.notes: Deliberate preparatory fragment completes in row150; Argo uses strength against Sai-copy's skill.

rows.en: I'll stand and fight!
I'll stand and fight!
Idiots! Switching opponents won't do you any good!!
As long as we have DG Cells, we cannot lose...!
Right! That's the power you don't have!
But the same goes for you!
rows.notes: Real Argo points out the copies also lack a power the originals possess.

rows.en: We have a power you don't... Now we'll show it to you!!
Club Ace, Sai Saici!!
rows.notes: Deliberate title/name declaration.

rows.en: Black Joker, Argo Gulski!
rows.notes: Deliberate title/name declaration.

rows.en: We, the Shuffle Alliance...!
rows.notes: Subject phrase continues into row159.

rows.en: Will destroy the devil reborn!
rows.notes: Predicate continues row158; capitalized for independent box.

rows.en: So that's the power of the Shuffle Crest!
Heh heh heh... You've finally decided to get serious...
rows.notes: The Sai Saici copy taunts the originals; identical speaker label preserved.

rows.en: Showing us that won't help you defeat us...!
rows.notes: Argo copy addresses the originals; speaker label preserved.

rows.en: You can say that after you've beaten us!
rows.notes: Original Sai answers the copies.

rows.en: Very well...! Come at us!
rows.notes: Argo copy accepts the originals' challenge.

rows.en: Gundam Fiiight!
rows.notes: Fight call continues through167 and original315, a deduplicated Go shout owned by stage05.

rows.en: Reaaady!
rows.notes: Ready call; the following Go belongs to a deduplicated source row.

rows.en: Gooooo!!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: Splendid, Sai Saici! And you too, Argo!
We've witnessed the Shuffle Alliance's power with our own eyes!
Heh heh... Well, that's what training does for you. Now my record against you, old man, is one win and one draw.
rows.notes: Sai claims one win and a draw against Argo;171 disputes whose win it was.

rows.en: Don't get the wrong idea, Sai Saici. I'm the one with a win and a draw.
You've got some nerve. Then let's settle this right here... is what I'd like to say, but...
rows.notes: Preserve deliberately unfinished challenge, interrupted by real enemy arrival.

rows.en: It seems our real opponent has arrived...!
Hyaaa-ha ha ha haa!
Th-that is...!?
Heavenly Sword, Peerless Blade! Gundam Heaven's Sword!!
rows.notes: Source-backed campaign epithet Heavenly Sword, Peerless Blade retained alongside sourced unit name; licensed English epithet unconfirmed.
uncertain: Independently licensed English epithet unconfirmed; sourced campaign wording retained.

rows.en: D-didn't Sai Saici and Argo defeat that thing!?
I've been waiting in hell for this moment! For the chance to rip you bastards to shreds with my legs!!
Hah! You can try as many comeback matches as you want, but the result won't change!
rows.notes: Comeback-match taunt retains repeated-loss meaning.

rows.en: Exactly...! Go quietly back to hell, Michelo Chariot!
But this time, I'm taking you with me! Until then, I'll keep coming back! Over and over and ooover!!
It seems words alone won't get through to you...
Then we'll just have to teach you with our fists!!
Hya ha ha! You're as stupidly carefree as ever!
I'll tell you this. You aren't the only ones who've gained new power... We have too!!
What...!?
Don't you think it's strange...!?
Why are we here when you supposedly destroyed us...? Why has the Devil Gundam come back now...?
Tch! You wouldn't tell us even if we asked!
Hya ha ha ha! Exactly!! You bastards can just shut up and diiie!!
I won't let you do that!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker label remains ??? despite Allenby reveal194.

rows.en: That's...!
rows.notes: Recognition fragment retained.

rows.en: The Gundam Fighter of love and justice! Nobel Gundam has arrived!!
rows.notes: Love/justice claim belongs to fighter while arrival identifies Nobel Gundam.

rows.en: Allenby!
It's been ages, you two! Sorry I'm late!
Huh? I wondered who it was, and it's one of our old pals!
Don't lump me in with a coward like you!
Someone who can't even fight without relying on DG Cells!
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation of198; no merging.

rows.en: Oh, really? If you feel like it, I could even bring Walter back for you, you know?
rows.notes: Walter is source-short name, not expanded to Walter Gundam.

rows.en: With our patron's power!
rows.notes: Patron rendering retains reverence without assigning unknown gender.

rows.en: Your patron...!?
rows.notes: Echoed patron question; unknown identity/gender retained.

rows.en: So someone really did revive the DG Cells!?
Yes! That's why we have to make him tell us who it is!
Idiots! You're going to die right here! By these silver legs of mine!!
Th-that's...!
The Argama...!? No, that's not it.
Oh, I get it! That's the Nahel Argama Domon told us about!
Captain, there's no doubt! It's a force of DG Cell mobile weapons!
rows.notes: Meaning corrected after draft: DG Cells identify the enemy weapon force; the weapons are not literally the cells themselves.

rows.en: And the Shuffle Alliance is there too...!
Man, I was sure we'd run into those Giganos guys, but...
Of all the enemies, we get the Devil Gundam's minions.
They're here... of all places...!
rows.notes: Thought; surprised location fragment preserves source trailing form.

rows.en: All right... All units, launch immediately.
This is Bright Noa, captain of the Nahel Argama. We'll provide support from here on.
I knew Bright would be the captain! We can't let him see us looking pathetic!
Right. Stay sharp, Sai Saici and Allenby.
I know, I know!
Heh heh heh... Now that they're here, this makes things simple!
I'll finish them off here, along with the Shuffle Alliance!!
Is that a Gundam too...!?
Hm? That's...!?
No mistake. That's the one our patron mentioned...! Why is it here with them...!?
rows.notes: Unknown sighted referent rendered neutrally as it; patron remains unidentified.
uncertain: Sighted target is not explicitly named in the local dialogue; neutral it retained.

rows.en: 1. Mothership shot down
rows.notes: Plain loss-condition label; no manual line break.

rows.en: We didn't get any leads after all...
No...
What did he mean... when he said the world would end?
If the DG Cells multiply and spread... all living things...
rows.notes: Sentence cut before predicate;229 completes absorption and broadens living things to everything.

rows.en: No, everything else too, will be absorbed into the Devil Gundam...
rows.notes: Completes228; source self-correction retained.

rows.en: You mean everything will become one?
Yes, that's right. Including the Vegan Empire forces in the Earth Sphere.

rows.notes: Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: If that happens, our world might as well be over.
The Devil Gundam will keep multiplying and evolving endlessly... Eventually, it might even swallow other star systems.
But as long as we're around, we won't let that happen.
Right. We'll follow the guidance of the Shuffle Crest.
rows.notes: Restored we will follow action; crest guides alliance.

rows.en: And the bonds we share with our new friends... right?
rows.notes: Poetic parallel clause tied to236; preserves the trailing flourish.

rows.en: ...Actually, we were planning to come and join you all. But it ended up the other way around.
rows.notes: Their intended movement was to join Bright; Bright instead came to them.

rows.en: No, it's fine. We welcome having you join us as well.
rows.notes: Bright welcomes their joining his group; direction retained.

rows.en: ...Domon told us what's going on. We'll be joining you from now on.
Good. That will be a great help.
Have you all known each other for a long time?
Yes. We fought together during the Devil Gundam incident a year ago.
By the way, Bright... Where are Amuro and Kamille?
rows.notes: Friendly big-brother addresses rendered by familiar names, per dropped honorific convention.

rows.en: Amuro should have joined up with the Nadesico B in space.
Then maybe he's met up with Chibodee and the others. What about Kamille?
rows.notes: Amuro is the person who may have met Chibodee; restores subject.

rows.en: He's recovering now. He regained consciousness after that... but he's still in no condition to fight.
rows.notes: Kamille is recovering; consciousness returned but combat remains impossible.

rows.en: I see... He didn't join the Gundam Coalition either...
rows.notes: Kamille is the omitted subject; restored.

rows.en: But I'm told he's making a steady recovery. There's no need to worry.
rows.notes: Kamille remains the subject of reported recovery.

rows.en: That's a relief, then.
Hey, what's the Gundam Coalition?
For the final battle against the Devil Gundam, every Gundam you could imagine gathered together...
rows.notes: Source connective leaves recollection open into253; retained trailing continuation.

rows.en: It was incredible!
rows.notes: Meaning/register correction: removed an added swear word that was not explicit in the source; excitement retained.

rows.en: Huh...
...Amuro told me he had nightmares for a while after that.
rows.notes: Amuro reported his own nightmares; duration retained.

rows.en: Well, I guess that's no surprise, after what they made him do.
rows.notes: Amuro was made to do something; source does not disclose the act.

rows.en: What on earth did he do?
rows.notes: Maria asks about Amuro, not Sai Saici.

rows.en: It's a secret! If I tell you, Amuro will get mad at me.
Now you've got me even more curious!
Anyway, Bright... Are we leaving right away?
No... We'll stay here for about four hours to gather information on the area... Did you have something in mind?
Since you came all the way to our place, why don't you stay and try our cooking?
rows.notes: Sai Saici invites Bright and party to eat the hosts cooking.

rows.en: Cooking...? What do you mean?
Sai Saici is also a first-rate cook.
Hehe, I hate to brag, but my fried rice is out of this world!
Really!? I wanna try it!
I want to try it too!
rows.notes: Restores desire to try the food from266.

rows.en: ...Chinese food would make a nice change. Sai Saici, could you cook for us?
rows.notes: Bright requests cooking from Sai Saici; request direction retained.

rows.en: Okay! I'll go get everything ready right now!
Yay!
Bright, you're wonderful!
D-don't tease your elders. ...Captain Katsuragi, tell everyone about the meal...
rows.notes: Captain Katsuragi per sourced rank. Meal announcement trails off when Bright discovers her absence.

rows.en: Hm? Where is she?
rows.notes: She refers to Misato/Katsuragi, explicitly female in glossary.

rows.en: Come to think of it, I haven't seen her for a while.
My sister's missing too...
rows.notes: Sister is Haruka, confirmed by280; preserve relational address.

rows.en: Where did they go...?
rows.notes: Plural they refers to both absent women.

rows.en: Hmm...
...I can't stop wondering about it.
rows.notes: Restores Haruka as curious speaker and Gundam as it.

rows.en: What's wrong, Misato?
You too, Haruka... Is something wrong with that Gundam?
rows.notes: Ayato addresses Haruka and asks about Nobel Gundam.

rows.en: How can I put it...
rows.notes: Hesitation retained; same wording works at both43 and48.

rows.en: It feels nostalgic, I guess...
rows.notes: Nostalgic allusion remains incomplete, without identifying series.
Punctuation-only bafflement retained.

rows.en: Hey, is my Nobel Gundam really that unusual?
Well, I wouldn't call it unusual...
rows.notes: False start retained rather than expanding explanation.
Three question marks retained.

rows.en: This Gundam... Does it throw a tiara or anything like that?
rows.notes: Tiara throwing allusion; no unspoken character name added.

rows.en: No, but it does use ribbons and a hula hoop...
rows.notes: It is Nobel Gundam using ribbons and hoop, not Allenby herself.

rows.en: Then does it say, "In the name of the moon," or something...
rows.notes: Incomplete catchphrase with source something-or-other retained; no punishment phrase invented.

rows.en: Or something about being doused in water...
rows.notes: Vague water allusion retained; no transformation/identity invented.
uncertain: Water allusion does not name its target or outcome; source-vague fragment preserved.

rows.en: Oh, isn't it "In the name of Mercury" these days...?
rows.notes: Mercury explicitly replaces moon in source joke; no explanation of voice-actor references added.

rows.en: Huh? Is it?
...What on earth are they talking about?
I-I have no idea...?
rows.notes: Stammer and uncertainty retained.

rows.en: Come now, everyone!
Please, help yourselves and eat as much as you like!
rows.notes: Keiun invites guests to eat; direction retained.

rows.en: I'm already eating!
rows.notes: Meaning correction: Kaine speaks about his own eating, so singular I replaces unsupported we.

rows.en: Man, this is good! Seriously good!
Hey, Tapp. Use a fresh plate for each dish, or the flavors will get mixed up.
rows.notes: Small individual plates, changed per dish; flavor-mixing consequence retained.

rows.en: Hey, Koji! Don't spin the table whenever you feel like it!
rows.notes: Rotating shared dining table; no invented travel meaning.

rows.en: Then dish up some for me too!
rows.notes: Koji asks Asuka to serve him; direction retained.

rows.en: Why should I have to do that for you!?
rows.notes: Asuka rejects serving Koji; restores for-you referent.

rows.en: That's proper etiquette for Chinese food, I'm telling you!
rows.notes: Koji asserts etiquette; source claim preserved.

rows.en: H-hey... What's this dish?
That's frog.
Whaaat!?
Try it. It's good.
B-b-but it's frog!?
They say the Chinese will eat anything with legs except chairs and tables.
rows.notes: Source stereotype translated with unchanged force, attributed as they say.

rows.en: ...This dish over here is sea snake.
rows.notes: Tetsuya branch introduces sea-snake dish before repeated311-318.

rows.en: S-snake!? C-can you eat that!?
rows.notes: Repeated shock works after either Tetsuya310 or male lead319; no branch-specific addressee invented.

rows.en: Yeah. I've even eaten ordinary snakes a few times while on missions.
rows.notes: Ordinary snakes distinguished from sea snakes; repeated mission context.

rows.en: What a coincidence. I ate them during survival training too.
rows.notes: Tetsuya shares survival-training experience.

rows.en: I-I can't believe it...!
I'll tell you this: there are a lot more edible things in the world than you think.
rows.notes: Male lead corrects female lead estimate; you referent restored.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... You eat the mushrooms growing in your room!?
rows.notes: Room mushrooms literal, not wild foraged mushrooms; question restores male lead eating. Meaning correction: speculative eating practice is not a completed act; changed ate to eat and removed added even.

rows.en: Oh, don't eat those. They'd do a lot more than just upset your stomach.
rows.notes: Danger beyond stomach upset retained; no exact toxicity invented.

rows.en: Y-you... You've led an even wilder life than I thought...
rows.notes: Astonishment at lived conditions retained without assigning details.

rows.en: ...So this dish over here is sea snake.
rows.notes: Male lead alternative branch introduces same sea-snake dish as310.

rows.en: So, in the end, we still haven't learned anything... about the Devil Gundam...
...Well, at this point, we can't rush it... We'll just have to take it slow...
...You're right... Still, this fried rice really is delicious.
Akira, it's rude to talk with your mouth full.
You too, Ryo and Benkei... You're not children anymore.
rows.notes: Ryo preserves source nickname; Ryoma speaker labels remain unchanged. You too retains context-linked scolding of table manners.

rows.en: Sorry, Sai Saici. Could I have another helping of fried rice?
You got it!
Brother, aren't you eating too much?
...The battles ahead will only get tougher. This will give me the energy I need to prepare for them.
Quit making excuses and just admit it's because it tastes good.
Hey, Sis! Are you allowed to be drinking beer!?
W-what are you talking about? This is barley tea, barley tea. Right, Misato?
That's right.
I don't think barley tea gets that foamy, though...
I knew it! That is beer!
It's fine, it's fine. I'm only having one glass... I'll go for a run afterward to burn off the alcohol.
Then both of you... Go for a run right now.
Huh?
Because we're having a meeting right after dinner.
Y-yes, sir...
Come on, come on! If you've got any requests, keep 'em coming!
Then I'd like... some shredded pork and green peppers.
Pan-fried dumplings... No, boiled dumplings!
rows.notes: Deliberate noun-phrase food order retained; listener is Sai Saici.

rows.en: Garlic ramen... without the roast pork.
rows.notes: Deliberate noun-phrase food order retained; listener is Sai Saici.

rows.en: I can... trust what you're telling me, right?
Yes. I'm sure it will be of use to you, Captain.
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and trailing source break.

rows.en: But... why do you, a Nergal employee, have this Psycho Frame?
...I believe Neo Zeon commissioned Anaheim to develop it during the last war.
And, as you know, Captain, since Haman Karn was defeated by the AEUG and the Federation forces...
rows.notes: Source sentence continues into row349; retained cutoff.

rows.en: It was supposed to be sealed away at Anaheim without ever reaching their hands.
rows.notes: Their hands refers to Neo Zeon; antecedent retained.

rows.en: So your people acquired it through illegal means?
I'll leave that to your imagination, but that Psycho Frame is something that isn't supposed to exist in this world.
So you're saying I can use it however I please?
Yes.
But as members of a corporate organization, you must be seeking a profit...
What do you want in return?
If you finish the new Gundam... and lend your support to the Nadesico B, that will do.
rows.notes: Restored requested action and listener: Amuro completes Gundam and helps Nadesico B.

rows.en: ...Understood. I was planning to join Bright's unit soon anyway.
Well, then...
rows.notes: Departure formula deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Yes. Please give my regards to your chairman.
rows.notes: Amuro asks Goat to convey regards to chairman.

rows.en: Captain Amuro...
You heard him, Chan. Please start the Nu Gundam's final adjustments right away.
Can we really trust them?
...I've never met Nagare Akatsuki, the chairman of Nergal Heavy Industries, but...
rows.notes: Source concessive trails off into row364.

rows.en: I hear he once served aboard the Nadesico A. I'd like to think he made this decision because he understands what it's like in the field.
Perhaps it's not my place to say this, but I haven't heard many good things about him...
Could there be some ulterior motive after all...?
That man would have done the same thing if he'd been on the other side...
rows.notes: Preserved unnamed man without naming or exposing identity. No gender inferred: male referent is explicit in source man.

rows.en: Huh?
No, it's nothing. More importantly, please hurry with the frame replacement.
Yes, sir.
...Captain Amuro, please come up to the bridge at once. There's something I need to tell you.
Understood. I'll be right there.
The Nadesico B is heading this way?
Yes. It has completed its operation on the moon and requested supplies from our ship.
The Nadesico... If I remember correctly, Domon and Rain were aboard it.
The Martian Successors... Ghosts of the Jovian Federation, eh?
Yes. Apparently, they attacked the Hisago Plan's terminal colonies, including Amaterasu.
At a time like this... That's trouble we don't need.
It seems the Nadesico B responded, but it was already too late...
rows.notes: Retained source trailing statement, with settled subject and action.

rows.en: So... where are they now?
rows.notes: Null speaker filled from sourced campaign alias for shortened Kasshu label.

rows.en: They've requested supplies from our ship and are heading this way.
Then the timing is perfect. I can give Rain the Rising Gundam now that its readjustments are finished.
She's joining this fight too?
Yes. I tried to stop her, but... She's stubborn, just like my son.
Hee hee, I'm rather jealous of her.
Even in the middle of a war, two people in love can be together...
rows.notes: Wistful trailing exclamation retained; complete subject/action restored.

rows.en: Acting Captain, please try not to give Bright too much trouble.
He may not look it, but he does seem a little afraid of his wife.
Don't worry. Captain Bright is the man I love in my heart.
But just once, I'd love to receive a confession as passionate as the one Rain got...
rows.notes: Rain is the recipient of the confession. Meaning correction removes confusing generic they; source wistful trailing wish retained.

rows.en: Were you there at the time too, just like Captain Amuro?
No, I watched it in the military's recorded footage.
Good grief. I feel sorry for Domon.
Captain Amuro, Giganos Metal Armors are approaching us!
What!? Giganos...!?
1. Amuro reaches the destination within 4 turns.
rows.notes: Victory condition; source plain kind retained.

rows.en: 1. Amuro fails to reach the destination within 4 turns.@2. Amuro is shot down.
rows.notes: Loss conditions; source plain kind and one @ retained.

rows.en: This is Captain Meio Plato of the Giganos Imperial Guard.
To the captain of the La Vie en Rose... Disarm and surrender immediately.
Meio Plato... The ace they call the Blue Hawk of Giganos.
rows.notes: Identifies Meio using sourced title.

rows.en: You have sixty seconds. If you refuse our demands, we will begin our attack.
...Captain, how long until the Nadesico B reaches this sector?
It will be here in five or six minutes at the earliest.
rows.notes: Restores arrival subject and verb.

rows.en: Then I'll buy us some time in the Nu Gundam.
That's reckless! You can't take on that many enemies!
Even so, we can't let the enemy take that machine.
I'll break out of the La Vie en Rose and return with the Nadesico.
A-Amuro...
Chan, don't worry. Lock down the other machines, then seal yourself in the innermost block with the captain and the others.
rows.notes: Chan locks down the other machines, then shelters with Emary and the others.

rows.en: I-I understand...
! Is that a Gundam-type!?
I haven't seen that machine before... It must be a new model.
The Moon, Earth... Capella, Vega. The Nadesico will be coming from that direction.
rows.notes: Amuro orients himself using the Moon, Earth and stars.

rows.en: All right, if I can get over there within four minutes...
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional cutoff retained.

rows.en: That machine's personal insignia... Could it be Amuro Ray?
What!?
A-Amuro Ray? You mean the pilot of the original Gundam...
rows.notes: Deliberate identification cutoff retained.

rows.en: Yes. He piloted the machine the Zeon forces once called the White Devil and feared.
rows.notes: White Devil describes the feared machine, not a newly assigned pilot title. Root confirmed White Devil via exact Akurasu epithet; source machine referent preserved.

rows.en: What is that Amuro Ray doing in a place like this...!?
He was probably involved in developing that new machine.
Heh heh... This is truly a gift from heaven. I've always wanted to meet that man.
Now, let's see how far I can draw them away...
rows.notes: Restores Amuro as subject of drawing enemies away.

rows.en: I will capture Amuro Ray and that Gundam. Practice Squad, follow me. The rest of you, seize the La Vie en Rose.
Heh, you're good. But I cannot back down so easily either.
rows.notes: Event5 battle/damage line; near-duplicate453 uses same wording.

rows.en: Grr! To think you could push me this far...!
I have no choice. I'm pulling back!
Amuro Ray! I thank God for this encounter!
So you did come after me!
You sided with the AEUG and Karaba! Why do you fight us, Giganos!?
Because you're hardly any different from Neo Zeon!
The Gundam and Amuro Ray... If I could shoot him down...!
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional cutoff retained.

rows.en: You're still a young soldier...! Don't throw your life away...!
Mine is an electronic warfare machine... With these Minovsky particles, I have the advantage...!
rows.notes: Electronic warfare advantage retained despite potentially surprising particle context. Root confirmed exact Minovsky particles from Akurasu.

rows.en: You won't survive on the battlefield if you rely on your sensors!
With this Jagd Gelf's firepower, I can take him!
Even if you've got more firepower, it doesn't matter if you can't hit me...!
rows.notes: Preserves firepower-versus-hit distinction.

rows.en: Open your eyes, Shuffle Alliance! We in Giganos fight for a just cause!
Ha! You hurl a rock at Earth, then talk about a just cause? You've got some nerve!
rows.notes: Stone euphemism for dropped object retained as rock; accusation not softened.

rows.en: Blue Hawk of Giganos! If you use force to realize your ideals, that is no different from violence!
But the Federation has learned nothing from the mistakes of Zeon and the Titans...!
Humanity has reached the point where it cannot survive if this continues!
Hey, Hawk! Have you given up chasing Kaine and the others!?
rows.notes: Kaine and the others remain explicit.

rows.en: I see the bigger picture. I came to space because I have a mission that takes priority over defeating the D-Weapons!
rows.notes: Restores mission priority as reason for going to space. Sourced spelling corrected from D Weapons to D-Weapons; no compression.

rows.en: Is that so! Then I've got all the more reason not to let you get away!
Withdraw your troops, Blue Hawk! Do you really think Giganos's methods are right!?
The times leave us no room to debate methods! As long as the ideals behind them are just, I take pride in what I do!
rows.notes: Defense of just ideals and personal pride retained.

rows.en: Here I come, Blue Hawk of Giganos! I'm not letting you steal my fried tofu!
rows.notes: Retains fried-tofu idiom setup so Hokuto can correct the bird in448.

rows.en: Ginga! It's a kite that steals fried tofu, not a hawk!
rows.notes: Kite/hawk correction retained literally; kite is the bird.

rows.en: A-Anyway! Here I come!!
rows.notes: Stammer preserved.

rows.en: Can you keep up with this Falguen in space!?
Ugh... He's good...! His speed is on a whole different level from inside the atmosphere!
rows.notes: Atmospheric-versus-space speed comparison explicit.

rows.en: I'll handle searching and tracking! #男愛称, concentrate on aiming!
rows.notes: Female copilot handles search/tracking; male lead aims; runtime nickname retained.

rows.en: Heh, you're good. But I cannot back down so easily either.
rows.notes: Event10 near-duplicate424; same wording.

rows.en: They've entered the La Vie en Rose's area. Acting Captain Emary, hang in there a little longer...!
! They had troops lying in wait!?
Meio, we shall assist you.
I don't recall asking you to do any such thing.
We know. But we need to lure them here and keep them occupied.
rows.notes: They intend to draw in and detain the Nadesico, settled by459.

rows.en: You mean the Nadesico. Then do as you please.
That was our intention from the start.
Those machines... Could they belong to a faction of the Martian Successors?
rows.notes: Amuro guesses affiliation; uncertainty remains in dialogue.

rows.en: What are those machines...!?
A-Acting Captain Emary, if this goes on...!
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional cutoff retained.

rows.en: There's no choice. I'll have to turn back!
...That will not be necessary.
rows.notes: Speaker remains hidden; formal voice retained.

rows.en: Yeah, let us take care of things here!
rows.notes: Speaker remains hidden; casual voice retained.
Reaction-only source retained.

rows.en: That's...!
rows.notes: Deliberate recognition fragment retained.

rows.en: The Gundam Rose and Maxter...!
rows.notes: Maxter is source short form of Gundam Maxter.

rows.en: The Gundam Rose and Maxter...!
rows.notes: Same reaction with alternate route-dependent speaker retained.

rows.en: The Shuffle Alliance!
Yeees! Queen the Spade, Chibodee Crocket, and...
rows.notes: Introduction continues into474; trailing and retained.

rows.en: Jack in Diamond, George DeSand... I have come to defend this great rose in bloom.
rows.notes: Great rose in bloom is a flourish on La Vie en Rose, not a new proper noun. Changed we have to I have: George introduces himself after Chibodee, retaining his personal formal declaration rather than adding a collective subject.

rows.en: This is Amuro Ray. I'm sorry to ask, but please defend the La Vie en Rose.
rows.notes: Amuro requests protection from the arrivals; direction restored explicitly.

rows.en: OK, leave it to us!
This reading...! They made it in time.
rows.notes: Sensor reading refers to Nadesico arrival, confirmed478.

rows.en: Hello. I'm Ruri Hoshino, captain of the Nadesico B, Federation Space Force. We will now provide support for your ship.
rows.notes: Radio introduction with full name and affiliation retained. Root added source-affiliation glossary entry; provenance limit retained.
uncertain: Federation Space Force transparently renders the MX source affiliation; exact licensed MX/Nadesico English label remains unestablished.

rows.en: This is the La Vie en Rose. Understood. Thank you for your support.
So you've come, Nadesico.
rows.notes: Group speaker kept as prefilled; addresses Nadesico.

rows.en: Those guys are here too!!
I see... So the Martian Successors and Giganos were in cahoots.
rows.notes: Explicit collusion between two factions retained.

rows.en: That unit... It's the one that showed up in Kyoto!
rows.notes: Kyoto recognition does not disclose unspoken unit or pilot identity.

rows.en: Well then, let's find out their real identity.
rows.notes: Identity target left broad: adversary/unit/pilot is not explicitly singled out. No hidden identity supplied. Meaning correction replaces who with identity to avoid restricting source to people.
uncertain: Exact target of identity inquiry is not stated; broad their retained.

rows.en: You're late, Domon!
Chibodee, George...! I didn't know you were here...
rows.notes: Domon addresses both arriving allies; incomplete surprise retained.

rows.en: It seems we're facing more than just the Devil Gundam's revival...
rows.notes: More-than-Devil-Gundam crisis retained.

rows.en: Though we're late in joining you, we too will take part in this battle.
rows.notes: George and Chibodee offer their participation.

rows.en: A-awesome...! There are two members of the Shuffle Alliance!
rows.notes: Explicit count two is retained.

rows.en: Th-they're the real thing, aren't they...?
rows.notes: Beecha asks whether the two arriving allies are genuine.

rows.en: Yes, without a doubt. The glow of their Shuffle Crests proves it.
rows.notes: Shuffle Crest sourced fixed term; refers to two allies crests.

rows.en: Anyway, we'll talk later! Let's take care of these guys first!
Right, got it!
Then, everyone... Please launch.
rows.notes: Ruri orders allied sortie.

rows.en: 1. Amuro is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat-condition list; preserve one @ and both complete conditions.

rows.en: We can't afford any more losses...! All units, retreat!
rows.notes: Meio orders enemy retreat.

rows.en: Captain, all enemy unit readings have disappeared.
rows.notes: Hari reports enemy readings, not proof enemies destroyed.

rows.en: Then please bring the Nadesico into La Vie en Rose's dock.
rows.notes: Ruri requests Hari dock the ship; direction retained.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Both numeric-use contexts checked: docking acknowledgment and later sortie-order acknowledgment.

rows.en: Thank you, Lieutenant Commander. You saved us.
rows.notes: Naval Lieutenant Commander rank from sourced Ruri profile, not army Major.

rows.en: No, I'm just glad we managed to arrive in time.
I'm sorry to ask right away, but could you resupply the Nadesico?
rows.notes: Ruri requests supplies from Emary; direction retained.

rows.en: Yes, of course.
...It's been a while, Domon.
Dad... You've been here on La Vie en Rose?
rows.notes: Dad is Dr. Kasshu; here aboard supply ship.

rows.en: Yes. They've allowed me to readjust the Rising Gundam here.
Then does that mean...?
rows.notes: Rain tentative unfinished implication about Rising; retained without invented completion.

rows.en: I'd like you to use the Rising. And please keep helping Domon from now on.
rows.notes: Dr. Kasshu asks Rain use the source-short Rising and continue assisting Domon.

rows.en: Yes, I will.
Well, Dad... About the DG Cells...
rows.notes: Incomplete topic introduction retained.

rows.en: Yes... I never imagined they would return after we'd supposedly disposed of them completely...
rows.notes: DG Cells referent from509 restored; supposedly complete disposal and unexpected return retained.

rows.en: When I first heard about it, I couldn't believe my ears either...
And I hear clones of us, Sai Saici and Argo have even shown up?
rows.notes: Us includes Chibodee and George; Sai Saici and Argo separately named.

rows.en: Yeah...
rows.notes: Ignore stray closing wrapper/trailing @ per brief; translate assent.

rows.en: Chibodee, did you and George encounter the Death Army?
rows.notes: You plural resolved as Chibodee and George by515.

rows.en: No. George and I were investigating mainly around the colonies, but...
rows.notes: Investigators are Chibodee and George; unfinished connective into516 retained.

rows.en: We found no sign of them, even at the Neo Japan colony the Devil Gundam tried to take over last time.
rows.notes: They refers to Death Army; attempted prior takeover was Devil Gundam action.

rows.en: Then so far they've only appeared on Earth...
rows.notes: Death Army ground-only appearances; ignore stray wrapper/tail per brief.

rows.en: Perhaps Argo, Sai Saici, Allenby and the others have found some sort of clue.
rows.notes: Source names plus others retained; no assumption of new character genders.

rows.en: Then those three are on Earth?
rows.notes: Three refers to Argo, Sai Saici, Allenby.

rows.en: Yes. They should have met up at the Shaolin Temple, where Sai Saici is staying.
rows.notes: Meetup remains expected, not confirmed; Sai Saici at Shaolin Temple.

rows.en: They said they planned to contact the Nahel Argama team after that.
rows.notes: Argo/Sai Saici/Allenby planned to contact Nahel Argama team; direction retained.

rows.en: Then the whole Shuffle Alliance will be together again for the first time in a while.
rows.notes: Whole alliance reuniting, not merely two already present.

rows.en: Yes. As inheritors of the Shuffle Crests, we cannot ignore this crisis in the Earth Sphere.
rows.notes: Shuffle Crest and Earth Sphere terminology; shared duty retained.

rows.en: ...Dr. Kasshu, did you have a chance to look at the data I sent you?
rows.notes: Rain sent data; Dr. Kasshu is asked about examining it.

rows.en: Yes. As you predicted, the cells seem to have been regenerated using unknown technology.
rows.notes: Regenerated objects are DG Cells, resolved by509/527; unknown technology retained.

rows.en: Unknown technology...? Even you can't figure it out, Dad?
rows.notes: Domon asks even father cannot identify technology.

rows.en: Yes. Not only do they resist the vaccine I developed, their performance has improved since last time...
rows.notes: Cells resist vaccine and improved performance; distinct facts retained.

rows.en: Of course, I'm still analyzing them... but there are far too many unknowns.
rows.notes: Analysis continues while uncertainty remains.

rows.en: The one thing we know for certain... is that someone is bringing the Devil Gundam back to life.
rows.notes: Unknown someone is restoring Devil Gundam, still in process; no hidden identity supplied.

rows.en: That's right... Since the Death Army has appeared, the thing that spawned it must exist somewhere.
rows.notes: Death Army implies a parent source exists; no location invented.
Silence only; stray wrapper/tail ignored per brief.

rows.en: ...In any case, we know what we have to do.
rows.notes: We is alliance speakers; intended action settled by533.

rows.en: Yeah. No matter how many times that thing comes back, we'll smash it with our fists.
rows.notes: Smashing revived enemy with their fists retains threat force.

rows.en: I know. I won't let that tragedy happen again.
rows.notes: Domon refuses recurrence of prior tragedy.

rows.en: Domon...
Dad, I'm going. For my master, my brother Kyoji, Schwarz... and for ourselves.
rows.notes: Brother relationship explicitly source-backed; Kyoji remains source-short rather than expanded surname. Master title remains unspecific.

rows.en: And this time, I'll defeat that devil...!
rows.notes: Source calls enemy that devil; no identity exposition added.

rows.en: ...I reviewed the data from that battle, and found no abnormalities in the Psycommu systems.
rows.notes: Chan reviewed recent battle data, no anomaly observed; Psycommu sourced spelling.

rows.en: Yes, it seems to work well with me too.
rows.notes: Nu Gundam works compatibly with Amuro, not Chan.

rows.en: That will reduce the suit's weight by 3 kilograms, though...
rows.notes: Three-kilogram reduction literal; incomplete caution preserved without adding cause.

rows.en: That's within acceptable limits. Then I'll take it as it is.
rows.notes: Amuro accepts reduction and takes unit as is.

rows.en: Um, Captain...
rows.notes: Captain rank from sourced Amuro profile.

rows.en: What is it?
The Nu Gundam still needs adjustments. Besides...
rows.notes: Incomplete addition after Nu Gundam adjustment need retained.

rows.en: There's no time. I'll do the fine-tuning aboard the Nadesico.
rows.notes: Amuro will perform fine adjustments aboard Nadesico.

rows.en: ...Are you telling me not to come with you? Amuro...
rows.notes: Follow direction settled by549: Chan asks whether she must stay behind; no reversal.

rows.en: Chan...
You designed the Nu Gundam, and I'm the one who maintains it. So I'd like to...
rows.notes: Designed by Amuro, maintained by Chan; unfinished desire to accompany retained. Meaning correction: unfinished wish to accompany replaces added duty implication should.

rows.en: No. You'll stay here and help Acting Captain Emary.
rows.notes: Amuro orders Chan to remain and assist Emary in acting captain role.

rows.en: Amuro...
...Once Dragoons enter combat service, the Federation will launch a major offensive on Giganos's lunar homeland...
rows.notes: Conditional Dragoon combat deployment triggers Federation lunar offensive; homeland/moon/large-scale retained. Compressed only after measured4-line overflow: combat deployment, Federation actor, major offensive and lunar homeland all retained.

rows.en: And when that happens, La Vie en Rose will be the key to resupply and maintenance.
rows.notes: Supply ship crucial for both resupply and maintenance.
Repeated silence retains both uses.

rows.en: So please stay here and wait for me to come back.
rows.notes: Amuro requests Chan await his own return here; direction retained.

rows.en: ...Understood.
I'm sorry, Chan.
...Well, I'm off.
Yes... Please come back soon...
rows.notes: Chan wishes Amuro early return; not a request to come along.

rows.en: Captain, resupply is complete, and the Nu Gundam and Rising Gundam have been brought aboard.
rows.notes: Hari speaker preserved. Both resupply and loading two units complete. Repeated report works before either departure branch.

rows.en: Then we'll now set course for Earth.
rows.notes: Ruri orders departure after supplies and Gundams have been loaded; ship/we subject restored. Earth branch ending.

rows.en: Then we'll now carry out our mission to investigate the Hisago Plan.
rows.notes: Alternative branch ending after same loading report; ship/we subject and investigation mission restored. Hisago Plan matches glossary.
